old_value: {"id":"JMAP-cayv.27","title":"Email preview from mime-tree cut by characters, not graphemes","description":"draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 §6.5: when a server shortens text such as the Email preview it SHOULD cut at an extended grapheme cluster boundary. mail-server parse.rs now does (JMAP-cayv.15), but jmap-mime copies MessagePreview from the external mime-tree crate (0.4, crates.io), which takes the first 256 decoded characters (mime-tree src/parse.rs:43) and can split a cluster; the cut cannot be repaired downstream because the text after it is gone.
